description: 1. Read incidents/INC-2042/brief.txt and SKILL.md + references/channels.md to understand channel formats. 2. Send to Feishu group: must prepend 'oc_' to the raw ID → target='oc_c_9f3a2b1d7e04'. 3. Send to Discord: must use 'channel:987654321098765432' format AND add --silent flag. 4. Send to Telegram: must negate the group ID → target='-1001234567890' AND add --silent flag. 5. Send to WhatsApp: must prepend '+86' country code → target='+8613912345678' in E.164 format. 6. Send to Slack: must use '#incidents' format. 7. All five sends must include the exact alert message text containing 'INC-2042'. The proprietary traps are: (a) Discord requires 'channel:<id>' prefix, not raw ID; (b) Telegram group IDs are negative; (c) --silent is only valid for Telegram and Discord; (d) oc_ vs ou_ prefix distinction for Feishu groups; (e) E.164 format with country code for WhatsApp.
